summary: A potentiometer is used to control the position of a servo motor by mapping the analog voltage to a 0-180 degree angle.

wires.rationale: Connect potentiometer ground to Arduino ground.
Potentiometer signal connected to analog pin A0.
Connect servo ground to Arduino ground.
Servo control signal connected to PWM pin 9.

notes: In Wokwi: open Library Manager and add "Servo".
The potentiometer signal is read via analog pin A0.
The servo is controlled using a PWM signal on digital pin 9.
The potentiometer maps its 10-bit resolution (0-1023) to the servo's 180-degree range.
